_comment_apiUrl: Base URL the integration test suite (test/api.ts) points at. It lives here rather than only in the gitignored config/local-test.json so `npm run test:integration` works from a bare checkout, e.g. in CI. Override with MIBI_API_URL.

server._comment_apiVersion: Version segment of every API route, e.g. v2 -> /v2/info. Change it here, not in the code.

_comment_resultsApiKey: Shared secret for POST /v2/orders/results. Empty by default so the route fails closed; set it per environment via MIBI_RESULTS_API_KEY.
_comment_dataEncryptionKey: Base64 32-byte AES key the parse cloud code uses to encrypt sensitive fields (Order, Sample, Result, User_Info, users). Empty by default so saves fail closed; set it per environment via MIBI_DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY and never change or lose it, or stored data becomes unreadable.
